referenceSources.title: 「特許リジットカラーS2000」、雨のS耐富士で4位獲得 | autosport web
referenceSources.description:
A blue and yellow Honda S2000, car number 95, powers through a wet turn at Fuji Speedway during the Super Taikyu Series. The vehicle’s livery displays sponsors such as Patent Rigid Color, TPJ, and Spoon, while its slick tires struggle for grip on the rain-slicked asphalt. Spray from the rear tires highlights the challenging conditions faced by the drivers.

Despite heavy rain and an exhaust failure mid-race, the #95 team of Naoki Hattori, Takayuki Kinoshita, and Takeshi Matsui secured a fourth-place finish in the four-hour endurance event. Their strategic pit stops and consistent lap times allowed them to maintain second place in the championship standings heading into the next round at Okayama International Circuit.
